items.detail: Left Wednesday's win over Miami after 17 minutes with a recurrence of left hamstring tightness (injury began last week vs. Brooklyn); MRI expected Thanksgiving and no ruling yet for Friday at Indiana.
Day-to-day tag is an illness: he missed both Wednesday's game vs. Miami and the prior loss to Portland, with no Friday status yet.
Turned his left ankle late vs. OKC and was helped off unable to bear weight; Finch said it 'looked pretty bad' and there is no team update for Friday vs. Memphis.

Listed Out in the brief, but after missing five games with a left heel contusion he practiced Wednesday and his status for Friday at San Antonio is undecided; a return would cut into Grimes/Sexton usage.

note: Morning run for the Nov 27 slate (Thanksgiving, no games Nov 26); no Friday rulings published yet for Brown, Embiid, Ball or Reaves.
